environment.description: Azure App Service (B2 tier) running behind Azure Application Gateway with no WAF policy attached. The Application Gateway performs SSL termination and round-robin load balancing only. No rate limiting is configured at any layer. The SQL Server backend is Azure SQL Database with db_datareader and db_datawriter permissions granted to the application identity. Network Security Group allows inbound HTTPS from 0.0.0.0/0.

config.gateway: Azure Application Gateway v2, no WAF SKU
